### [Link to section: AI for modern operations](https://grafana.com/\#ai-for-modern-operations) AI for modern operations

Use [Grafana Assistant](https://grafana.com/products/cloud/ai-assistant?pg=hp&plcmt=txt-img-alternating) to understand production telemetry, [Investigations](https://grafana.com/products/cloud/investigations?pg=hp&plcmt=txt-img-alternating) to accelerate root cause analysis, and [Agent Observability](https://grafana.com/products/cloud/agent-observability?pg=hp&plcmt=txt-img-alternating) to evaluate and improve production AI agents. All in one OpenTelemetry-native platform.

[Grafana Cloud AI Assistant](https://grafana.com/products/cloud/ai-assistant?pg=hp&plcmt=txt-img-alternating)

### [Link to section: Cut costs. Only pay for the data that matters. ](https://grafana.com/\#cut-costs-only-pay-for-the-data-that-matters) Cut costs. Only pay for the data that matters.

Half of telemetry spend is wasted. Grafana Cloud’s Adaptive Telemetry suite automatically identifies the data worth your attention and aggregates the rest, cutting your telemetry costs by up to 80%.

[Cost optimization](https://grafana.com/products/cloud/adaptive-telemetry?pg=hp&plcmt=txt-img-alternating)
